The '''Massassi Guardian carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] used during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was named after the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], the [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of an ancient [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] race.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi Guardian carbine appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MGC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Massassi Guardian carbine was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:MGC" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
